malicious_sets.note: B depends only on (N, m, mal_seed): the same three malicious sets are reused for every partition draw; certified accuracy does not depend on B

feature_processing.iot23: 9 log-signed numeric fields incl. resp_p (destination port); one-hot of the top 4 proto / 12 conn_state / 8 service values, vocabulary taken from ALL rows (train+test); no IP addresses, no timestamp, no uid
feature_processing.standardisation: mean/sd of the pooled training rows of all households (a server-side statistic in a real federation), applied to test rows
feature_processing.split: time-ordered tail (last 20%) within each capture (IoT-23) / within each capture x traffic-type file (N-BaIoT): every test capture is also a training capture
